title: fetch_session/call: resp shadowing via inline block obscures auth-check pattern
description: client.rs lines 140-144 and 198-202: the send/check/promote sequence is duplicated twice as an inline block with variable shadowing (raw_resp -> resp). The reader must look inside the block to see the three steps; the shadowing hides that the pre-check raw_resp and the post-check resp are different objects. Extract fn send_and_check(response: reqwest::Response) -> Result<reqwest::Response, ClientError> { Self::check_auth_status(response.status())?; response.error_for_status().map_err(ClientError::Http) } and call it at both sites.
